name: NGC 4648 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4648, a nearby spheroidal galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4648-hubble
story: NGC 4648 is one of a set of faint nearby spheroidal galaxies Hubble imaged in a census of quietly feeding black holes and the dense star clusters that sit at galaxy centers.

claims.text: NGC 4648 is one of 31 faint nearby spheroidal galaxies in a Chandra/HST snapshot survey
The survey looked for accreting black holes and nuclear star clusters
